text: キラキラと　きんいろに　ひかる　じゅんきん　せいの　たま。

structure.jp: キラキラと　きんいろに　ひかる
じゅんきん　せいの　たま。
structure.en: a ball made of pure gold

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: キラキラと　きんいろに　ひかる　じゅんきん　せいの　たま
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes it, like 'that...' in English. きんいろに　ひかる　じゅんきん　せいの　たま = 'a pure-gold ball that shines gold'.

patterns.name: 〜と (how)
patterns.explanation: と after a sound-picture word shows the way something happens. キラキラと = 'with a sparkle', 'sparklingly'.
